headline: 6 killed in gunman attack at mother and child center in Stade, Germany
summary: A gunman opened fire at a mother and child center, injuring several others. Police suspect a family dispute may be behind the violence, which has spread fear in the small city.
details: At least six people were killed and several others injured in a shooting incident in Germany. The attack occurred on Monday, June 29, when a gunman opened fire indiscriminately inside a mother and child center in the city of Stade.

Security forces responded to the scene and apprehended three individuals, including the suspected gunman. Police believe a family dispute may have been the motive behind the killings, and an investigation has been launched to determine the exact cause.

Police records indicate that the suspected attacker, a 45-year-old German citizen of Turkish descent, had a prior criminal record. The incident has caused widespread panic in the city of Stade, which has a population of only 50,000 residents.
However, security forces have announced that there is currently no further threat to the residents.
